{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect basic info
print(df.info())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nValues of -1 in customer_age:', (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue column: is it string with commas?
print('\nSample of revenue column:', df['revenue'].head().tolist())

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nStatus distribution:', df['status'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Check for QA orders
print('\nRevenue values of 999999.99:', (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
